sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6266 of 2024
Applicant :- Amit Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Vandana Rawat,Yuga Raj Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.0785 of 2023 under sections 363, 366, 376 IPC read with section 3/4 POCSO Act, P.S. Pihani, District Hardoi.
3. The FIR was lodged as a missing person report.
Subsequently, in the statement under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., the victim disclosed her age as 18 years and did not support the prosecution story.
He stated that both of them have married and there is no document on record to conclusively form any opinion with regard to age of the victim at this stage.
Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl.

entities.text: Amit Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Considering the two statements not supporting the prosecution story, the applicant who is in custody since 07.02.2024 and has no criminal history, he is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Amit Kumar be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.7.2024/VNP/-
